newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police say Paris hostage-taking incident ended.
newsitem.headline: Police say Paris hostage-taking incident ended.

text.p: All of the hostages seized on Friday by an armed man in central Paris have been freed and the man has been taken into custody, a police spokeswoman said.
"Everyone has been freed. The perpetrator of the hostage-taking has been apprehended," the spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.

The 55-year-old man, armed with a hunting rifle and described by police as a disgruntled former employee of a private bank, had taken 35 people hostage at around 1 p.m. (1200 GMT) at the bank's offices on Boulevard Haussmann in the capital's business eighth district.
Two people shot and slightly wounded in the incident were released by the gunman to be taken to hospital as police quickly sealed off the area and surrounded the building.
The last one was set free at around 3 p.m. (1400 GMT), police officials said.
